verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Browser Use operates as a goal-driven agent that completes tasks like filling forms or extracting data (browser-use-gh-1, browser-use-gh-2, browser-use-docs-20), implying underlying DOM-understanding navigation rather than brittle selectors, and community reports confirm it works against real logged-in sites (browser-use-comm-5). However the evidence never documents explicit low-level 'act/click/type on described element' primitives as a developer-facing API, nor any explicit claim/testing of selector-change resilience. missing for 10: explicit action-primitive API docs (click/type functions), documented resilience to selector/layout changes, independent benchmark of primitive-level robustness.
